status.schwarzschild_profiles: exactly represented using GR-toolkit profiles; not independently derived
status.stress_tensor: standard tensor from the proposed two-scalar action
status.source_sector: proposed and exercised with a toy smooth source

schwarzschild_mapping.interpretation: The metric is represented exactly once the GR profile is supplied.

covariant_program.action: S = integral sqrt(-g) [c^4 R/(16 pi G) - 1/2 K_IJ grad(q^I).grad(q^J) - U(q) + L_m] d^4x, q=(alpha,nu); phase theta defines the future-directed congruence u_mu.
covariant_program.stress_tensor: T^bubble_mn = K_IJ partial_m q^I partial_n q^J - g_mn[1/2 K_IJ partial_r q^I partial^r q^J + U(q)].
covariant_program.field_equations: K_IJ box q^J - dU/dq^I = -J_I; Einstein/GR toolkit: G_mn = (8 pi G/c^4)(T^matter_mn + T^bubble_mn).
covariant_program.phase_role: u_mu = -grad_mu theta/sqrt(-grad theta squared) fixes future time orientation

toy_source.source: smooth Gaussian with total solar mass
toy_source.note: Toy closure only; beta and lambda are not derived.

forward_time_inward.definition: s=r_ref-r, so inward dr/dtau<0 implies ds/dtau>0
